method: Built-in image_gen, reference-based cover generation. WebP encoding with cwebp; source images unchanged.

covers.name: tab-volume-manager
covers.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a premium portfolio project cover for the browser extension "Tab Volume Manager". Reference image is its existing brand visual; preserve its deep midnight blue and metallic cobalt speaker materials. Wide 16:9 landscape composition, 1536x864 or similar. One monumental sculptural speaker cone on the right, tightly cropped, beautiful brushed aluminum rings, dark fine woven diaphragm, directional cool blue studio light. Left 44% deep navy negative space. Large impeccably typeset white Swiss grotesk title on the left, exactly "Tab Volume" on first line and "Manager" on second line. Use generous margins, restrained editorial composition, high-end audio art direction, subtle photographic grain. Only text is that title, no captions, features, marketing prose, badges, logos or fake application UI. Title must read clearly at thumbnail size. Flat edge-to-edge cover image, no outer frames, no rounded corners.
